title: Five Militants Killed in Panjgur, Balochistan Intelligence-Based Operation
detail: Pakistani security forces killed five militants affiliated with Fitna al-Hindustan (Pakistan's term for India-linked Baloch separatist networks) during an intelligence-based operation in Panjgur district, Balochistan. ISPR said a large cache of weapons, ammunition, and IEDs was recovered and destroyed at the site.
